config.title: Clusters
config.description: Clusters registered with Prism Central

config.title: Hosts
config.description: Hypervisor hosts across every cluster

config.title: VMs
config.description: Virtual machines that are powered on, out of every VM Prism Central manages

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "powerState[Expanded].rawState" = 'ON') AS "poweredOn", COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM "vms"

config.title: Inefficient VMs
config.description: VMs Prism flags as over-provisioned, under-provisioned, inactive or constrained, across all clusters

config.title: Open Alerts
config.description: Unresolved critical and warning alerts. Red or amber means something needs attention

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "severity[Expanded].rawState" = 'CRITICAL') AS "critical", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "severity[Expanded].rawState" = 'WARNING') AS "warning" FROM "alerts") SELECT 'Critical' AS "severity", CASE WHEN "critical" > 0 THEN 'error' ELSE 'success' END AS "state", "critical" AS "alerts", 1 AS "position" FROM a UNION ALL SELECT 'Warning', CASE WHEN "warning" > 0 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'success' END, "warning", 2 FROM a

config.title: Cluster Health
config.description: Operational status of each cluster, with its AOS version, node count and VM count

config.title: Alerts by Severity
config.description: Open alerts split by severity

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT CASE "severity[Expanded].rawState" WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Info' END AS "severity", COUNT(*) AS "alerts" FROM "alerts" GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY CASE "severity" WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'Warning' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

config.title: VM Power State
config.description: How many VMs are on, off, paused or in an unknown state

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT CASE "powerState[Expanded].rawState" WHEN 'ON' THEN 'On' WHEN 'OFF' THEN 'Off' WHEN 'PAUSED' THEN 'Paused' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "state", COUNT(*) AS "vms" FROM "vms" GROUP BY 1

config.title: CPU Usage
config.description: Latest hypervisor CPU usage of each cluster, busiest first

config.title: Memory Usage
config.description: Latest hypervisor memory usage of each cluster, fullest first

config.title: Storage Usage
config.description: Latest share of physical storage used in each cluster, fullest first

config.title: CPU Usage Trend
config.description: Hypervisor CPU usage of each cluster across the timeframe

config.title: Memory Usage Trend
config.description: Hypervisor memory usage of each cluster across the timeframe

config.title: Controller IOPS
config.description: Cluster-wide controller I/O operations per second

config.title: Controller Latency
config.description: Cluster-wide average controller I/O latency in milliseconds

config.title: Top VMs by CPU
config.description: The ten VMs using the most CPU on average across the timeframe

config.title: Top VMs by CPU Ready
config.description: VMs waiting longest for a physical CPU. Over 5% is contention worth investigating

config.title: Top VMs by Memory
config.description: The ten VMs using the most of their allocated memory

config.title: Open Alerts
config.description: Every unresolved alert, critical first. Click a row for the full message and resolution

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT CASE "severity[Expanded].rawState" WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Info' END AS "severity", "title" AS "alert", "sourceEntityName" AS "entity", "sourceEntityType" AS "entityType", "clusterName" AS "cluster", "creationTime" AS "raised", "possibleCause" AS "cause", "message", "resolution", CASE "severity[Expanded].rawState" WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS "rank" FROM "alerts" ORDER BY "rank", "creationTime" DESC

config.title: VMs per Cluster
config.description: How VMs are spread across clusters

config.title: AOS Versions
config.description: Clusters by AOS version. More than one slice means version drift

config.title: Hypervisor Versions
config.description: Hosts by hypervisor version. More than one slice means version drift
